title: Cokernel part of reduction torsion bound
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, $I,K$ quasi-coherent ideal sheaves, $F,H$ coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], and $a:F\to H$ a module morphism. If $t\ge1$ and $K^t$ annihilates $\ker(a)$ and $\operatorname{coker}(a)$, then for every $n\ge0$, $K^{2t}$ annihilates the cokernel of the induced map $F/I^{n+1}F\to H/I^{n+1}H$. Kernels, cokernels and ideal products are taken in the ambient category of $\mathcal O_X$-modules.

proof.text: The quotient projection H to H/I^(n+1)H followed by the reduced cokernel projection is epic and kills a. Mathlib cokernel.desc and cokernel.desc_epi give an epimorphism from coker(a) to the reduced cokernel. Tensoring it by K^t is epic, so naturality of multiplication transfers zero of the original ideal product to the reduced ideal product. formalModuleQuotient_factor with the identity and t <= 2*t factors the higher-power inclusion through this zero inclusion; its monicity gives the requested IsZero statement.

proof_origin.note: Independent second reading; kernel follows the source scalar quasi-inverse argument; cokernel uses its simpler categorical quotient argument.

lean.statement:
theorem coherentMap_reduction_torsion_coker
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (I K : X.IdealSheafData)
    (F H : CoherentModules X) (a : F ⟶ H) (t : ℕ) (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (hker : IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower K.toModulesι t).2
      (kernel a.hom)))
    (hcoker : IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower K.toModulesι t).2
      (cokernel a.hom))) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct
      (Scheme.idealSheafPower K.toModulesι (2 * t)).2
      (cokernel (formalModuleQuotientMap I a.hom (Nat.le_refl (n + 1)))))
